CPU: Intel® 7th/6th Gen Core i7/i5/i3 series, Intel® Celeron®, Intel® Pentium® processors; CPU TDP support up to 80W TDP
Note: BIOS version 2.0 or above is required to support 7th Generation Intel® Core™ Processors

SATA: SATA3 (6Gbps) via Intel® Q170 Express controller
IPMI: Support for Intelligent Platform Management Interface v.2.0
IPMI 2.0 with virtual media over LAN and KVM-over-LAN support
Network Controllers: Intel® PHY i219LM + Intel® i210AT Gigabit Ethernet LAN Controllers
Virtual Machine Device Queues reduce I/O overhead
Video: ASPEED AST2400 BMC and Intel HD Graphics 530

Video/Display: 2 DP (Display Port), 1 DVI-I from Intel® HD Graphics, 1 VGA from AST2400
3 Independent Displays from Processor Graphics, VGA is from AST2400 for BMC KVM
SuperDOM: 1 SuperDOM (Disk on Module) port with built-in power

Power Configurations: CPU Fan auto-off in sleep mode
Power-on mode for AC power recovery

Fans: 4x 40x56mm PWM fan; 2x fans for AOC cooling
